rationale: alerts-content-templates.spec.js already covers the core E2E multi-channel rendering path (content template creation, preview panel, destination binding, alert firing, wire-payload assertions, render_format override). alerts-template-prebuilt-guard.spec.js covers list-level UI (tabs, badges, edit/clone CRUD, validation). alerts-help-drawer.spec.js covers the help drawer. Gaps remain for: custom mode creation, content-mode optional sections (links/rows/channel-titles/chart), delete/bulk-delete flows, test send, variable guide, export, and legacy banner migration. These are content-template-specific and belong in the content-templates spec via append.
